description: This file implements memory allocation utility functions with additional logging and error handling. It includes functions for malloc, calloc, realloc, and free, with mechanisms to handle failed allocations by logging and possibly aborting.

methods.name: void handle_failed_alloc(char const * func,size_t size,char const * file,int line,int do_abort)
methods.description: Handles failed memory allocations by logging error details and aborting the process if specified.

methods.name: void * rt_malloc_at(size_t size,char const * file,int line,int do_abort)
methods.description: Allocates memory and handles failure with logging and optional abort.

methods.name: void * rt_calloc_at(size_t num,size_t size,char const * file,int line,int do_abort)
methods.description: Allocates zero-initialized memory block and handles failure similarly.

methods.name: void * rt_realloc_at(void * ptr,size_t new_size,char const * file,int line,int do_abort)
methods.description: Reallocates memory and handles failure with logging and optional abort.

methods.name: void rt_free_at(void * ptr,char const * file,int line,int do_abort)
